package emptybody_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/emptybody/gen/http/inline_body/client"
	server "example.com/emptybody/gen/http/inline_body/server"
	service "example.com/emptybody/gen/inline_body"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestExplicitEmptyBodies(t *testing.T) {
	endpoints := &service.Endpoints{
		EmptySelected: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return &service.EmptySelectedResult{Body: &service.EmptyRecord{}, H: "kept"}, nil
		},
		EmptyType: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return &service.EmptyRecord{}, nil
		},
		EmptyError: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return nil, &service.EmptyFailure{Name: "empty", Body: &service.EmptyRecord{}}
		},
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer host.Close()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		path   string
		status int
		header string
		value  string
	}{
		{"empty_selected", http.StatusOK, "X-Label", "kept"},
		{"empty_type", http.StatusOK, "", ""},
		{"empty_error", http.StatusBadRequest, "X-Error", "empty"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.path, func(t *testing.T) {
			response, err := host.Client().Get(host.URL + "/" + tc.path)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, response.StatusCode)
			require.Equal(t, "{}", strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
			if tc.header != "" {
				require.Equal(t, tc.value, response.Header.Get(tc.header))
			}
		})
	}
	address, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	c := client.NewClient(address.Scheme, address.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	value, err := c.EmptySelected()(t.Context(), nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result := value.(*service.EmptySelectedResult)
	require.NotNil(t, result.Body)
	require.Equal(t, "kept", result.H)
	value, err = c.EmptyType()(t.Context(), nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, value.(*service.EmptyRecord))
	_, err = c.EmptyError()(t.Context(), nil)
	var failure *service.EmptyFailure
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &failure)
	require.NotNil(t, failure.Body)
	require.Equal(t, "empty", failure.Name)
}
